# seawall

> A single static binary that finds every piece of cryptography in your
> codebase, dependencies, X.509 certs, and TLS endpoints — then classifies
> against NIST's post-quantum migration timeline and emits standards-compliant
> CycloneDX 1.7 CBOM, SARIF 2.1.0, and an auditor-grade HTML report.
> Deterministic. Offline. Trust invariants P1-P4 (see README.md).

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): project overview, positioning, quickstart, trust invariants
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): build spec; every section traces to a D-NN decision in knowledge/11-decisions/
- [seawall/MCP.md](seawall/MCP.md): MCP wire contract — the spine between the deterministic scanner and any agent layer
- [knowledge/README.md](knowledge/README.md): research and decisions index

## Wire contract

- [seawall/crates/core/schema/](seawall/crates/core/schema/): JSON Schemas (Draft 2020-12)
- 11 MCP verbs documented in seawall/MCP.md §3
- P3 enforced: provenance enum = ["deterministic"] only in OSS
